entries.8f2ca964cdb1af30: As an independent system integrator, it has a structure that allows it to propose the latest technologies without being tied to specific hardware or middleware, and it has built up a track record of more than 35 years since its founding in 1990. In the social infrastructure fields of the public sector, telecommunications, finance, energy, and transportation and logistics, it has accumulated track record and know-how in core system development and network infrastructure construction, which it uses to secure stable orders through long-term continuing transactions with customers. It also owns in-house products, including the Wisebook digital book and the DynaCAD series of general-purpose CAD.
